 Post published at 85' 85' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Rogers Mato doesn't give Franculino a second as he attempts to barge his way into the Hearts box. Mato says no. Brilliant defending from the striker filling in at left-back.

 CLOSE! published at 83' 83' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Beau Reus claims a Noah Saviolo shot in the Hearts goal and the Jambos head up the other end with Josh McPake, who drags wide his attempt from the angle.
 40 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:28 BST 19:28 BST 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Brian McLauchlin 
BBC Sport Scotland in Trabzon 
 Chants of 'Celtic, Celtic' coming from the home fans...
 79 149 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 79' 79' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Game's hit a bit of a lull as the hosts keep the ball. Beau Reus then picks up a loose ball in the box but takes his time getting it back out. 
 9 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 76' 76' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Based on this display, Rogers Mato could find a home at left-back in this Hearts team. He's been great!
 124 15 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 75' 75' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 It's a triple change for Hearts now, with James Wilson, Calvin Miller and Sabri Guendouz making way. On come Josh McPake, Sabah Kerjota and JJ Williams.
 54 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 73' 73' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 I think this is one of these new time-wasting rules in action. 
 Aral Simsir has been ordered to go off just seconds after coming on. He doesn't have a clue what's going on. 
 He'll have to wait a minute before coming back on to the field as Trabzonspor play with 10.
 24 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 72' 72' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 And that's Mo Salah's night over. A goal and an assist. It's what he does... still.
 There's a bit of confusion with who else is coming off and who's coming on.
 Image source, SNS 
 44 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68' 68' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 This game is just starting to swing end to end.
 Mo Salah has the ball pinched off him when things start to look ominous for Hearts.
 42 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Discipline key' published at 19:13 BST 19:13 BST 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Brian McLauchlin 
BBC Sport Scotland in Trabzon 
 Discipline the key now for Hearts. There is no need to leave big spaces at the back for Trabzonspor to exploit. The home fans want more goals from their team, though.
 36 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Mato, stay back' published at 19:12 BST 19:12 BST 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Allan Preston 
Former Hearts defender on BBC Sportsound 
 The manager needs to say to Mato to stop going forward. Every time Trabzonspor are causing problems it's coming down that side. 
 35 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 64' 64' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Wouter Vrancken should be proud of his players, no doubt about it, but how much is his depleted team going to tire in the final half-hour? The risk of more injuries will only increase.
 47 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 62' 62' 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 There's a real risk Hearts get picked off here as Trabzonspor break with three on three. The Jambos recover will to prevent the attack developing into something serious, though.
 26 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Wonderful' published at 19:09 BST 19:09 BST 
 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts 
 Allan Preston 
Former Hearts defender on BBC Sportsound 
 It's a brilliant goal. Francolino plays a lovely little give and go with Salah and then curls it into the right-hand side of Reus' goal. 
 Image source, SNS
